title: The Tiny Cloud Bird That Becomes a Dragon
premise: Swablu looks like a tiny cloud-winged bird, obsessively keeps clean, then evolves into Dragon/Flying Altaria.
audiencePromise: Start with Swablu's adorable cloud-wing behavior, then reveal the surprising Dragon-type evolution hiding at level 35.
openLoop: How does this tiny cotton-winged bird end up becoming a Dragon type?
payoff: At level 35, Swablu evolves into Altaria and changes from Normal/Flying to Dragon/Flying.
engagementQuestion: Which design wins: tiny cloud bird Swablu or cloud dragon Altaria?

voice.instructions: Warm, playful Pokémon short narrator. Start with cute curiosity, make the cleaning behavior feel charming and weird, then land the Dragon-type evolution as the surprise. Keep it crisp, conversational, and natural. Never imitate a known person or character.

scenes.headline: THIS CLOUD BIRD BECOMES A DRAGON
scenes.narration: This tiny cloud bird eventually evolves into a dragon.
scenes.caption: CLOUD BIRD → DRAGON

scenes.headline: ITS WINGS LOOK LIKE CLOUDS
scenes.narration: Swablu is number three thirty-three, a Normal and Flying Cotton Bird Pokémon.
scenes.caption: COTTON BIRD POKÉMON

scenes.headline: IT CLEANS WITH ITS WINGS
scenes.narration: It wipes away dirt with its soft cotton-like wings and showers when dirty.
scenes.caption: WINGS = CLEANING CLOTH

scenes.headline: THE CUTE BIRD STARTS CHANGING
scenes.narration: At level thirty-five, Swablu evolves and its typing changes.
scenes.caption: LEVEL 35 → EVOLUTION

scenes.headline: NOW IT'S A DRAGON
scenes.narration: It becomes Altaria, a Dragon and Flying Pokémon with huge cloud-like wings.
scenes.caption: ALTARIA • DRAGON + FLYING

scenes.headline: CLOUD BIRD OR CLOUD DRAGON?
scenes.narration: Cloud bird or cloud dragon: which design wins?
scenes.caption: SWABLU OR ALTARIA?
